# `theta_union`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Merges two binary representations of
Datasketches ThetaSketch objects using a ThetaSketch Union object. Users can set
lgNomEntries to a value between 4 and 26 to find the union of sketches with different
union buffer size values (defaults to 12).

**Applies to:** not available in Krishiv yet. Spark: 4.1 and later.

## Syntax

```text
theta_union(first, second, lgNomEntries)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not implemented yet |
| Group | `sketch_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.1 and later |
| Arguments | [2, 3] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- theta_union, example 1
> SELECT theta_sketch_estimate(theta_union(theta_sketch_agg(col1), theta_sketch_agg(col2))) FROM VALUES (1, 4), (1, 4), (2, 5), (2, 5), (3, 6) tab(col1, col2);
Error: KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 4.1.0.
